title: WAVE_9_output
universal_lens: A verification lattice where every citation exists as unverified lead until corpus-grounded; API failure induces null retrieval, collapsing the inference chain to raw unverified output. The system enforces epistemic closure via mandatory verification passes that append findings, creating a monoidal structure over (lead, verified, appended) states.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats each quote as a conformal prediction set with coverage guarantee conditional on corpus verification. The API error manifests as empty retrieval set, triggering maximal uncertainty quantification. Bayesian updating halts at prior; verification pass acts as posterior calibration layer ensuring no ungrounded lead contaminates downstream odds.
gse_mapping: GSE models the wave as state machine: {IDLE, RETRIEVING, GENERATING, VERIFYING, APPENDING}. API-ERROR-AFTER-RETRY forces transition to ERROR sink state with zero chunks retrieved. Situational reasoning requires fallback to null-action policy; state-transition telemetry logs elapsed time, document count, and error HTML as observable invariants.

Verification pass acts as auditor with power to append but not rewrite, creating a Stackelberg game where auditor moves last.
